minimum_explicit_refinement.scope: Focal successor revision; do not redesign the experiment or change the estimand, case, model, arm order, budgets or winner policy.
required_changes: Replace mandatory per-tool started_at/finished_at with required start_sequence and finish_sequence derived from immutable one-based JSONL line ordinals. Keep wall-clock timestamps optional and classify them Unknown when absent; never synthesize them.

Freeze normalized_event_id as SHA-256(thread.started.thread_id + NUL + item.id), normalized session_id as thread.started.thread_id, arm_id as invocation-derived, and exact canonical request/response hash algorithms.

Add a Codex CLI 0.149.0 native web_search JSONL fixture or an equivalent public schema witness. Define exact raw paths for query, status and locator. If the runtime event is unsupported, malformed or lacks query identity, classify the arm Unknown/invalid and stop without replacement.
Define precedence exclusively by completed Bateia lifecycle line before native web start line; do not require unavailable wall-clock timestamps for this ordering predicate.

Freeze a catalysis execution profile with an auth-only CODEX_HOME, empty working directory, --ignore-user-config, --ignore-rules, --ephemeral, --skip-git-repo-check, read-only sandbox, no approval prompts, --output-schema, --json and --output-last-message.
Place --search before the exec subcommand: codex --search exec. The form codex exec --search is rejected by 0.149.0.

Freeze control with no MCP server and treatment with only the bateia server and enabled_tools=[bateia_recommend], plus a mechanically enforced one-call guard or fail-closed postcondition before any second Bateia call can be used.
